spec: §15 suite A; §7.4 suite-A sentence: f calls g, uncalls g, returns; g performs one clock.read; call f; uncall f leaves the clock at its entry value
derivation: g's clock.read writes the initial clock 0 and increments it to 1; the inner uncall reverses that frame (clock back to 0, tape entry popped); load then reads 0; uncall f skips the already-reversed frames. Result 0, clock 0, empty tape. Steps: nested 6 own instructions + f's call,effect,ret,uncall,ret = 11.
